summary: A Zoox automated test vehicle braked abruptly, reportedly injuring a contractor on board, according to OSHA injury data reported by TechCrunch.
Intuitive notified customers that a da Vinci 5 foot-pedal spring can fail and leave the pedal pressed; the correction was classified as a Class II recall. No injuries reported.
An unoccupied Zoox robotaxi driving autonomously collided with a passenger car; Zoox recalled software on 270 vehicles (NHTSA 25E-029). No injuries reported.
A Zoox test vehicle's software reportedly braked harshly, injuring an instructor in the back seat, according to OSHA injury data reported by TechCrunch.
A driverless Apollo Go robotaxi carrying a passenger fell into a fenced-off construction pit; the passenger got out uninjured with help from residents.
A Zoox robotaxi made a wide turn into the opposing lane and stopped in front of oncoming traffic; with 62 similar lane crossings, Zoox recalled software on 332 vehicles. No collisions.
A worker was pinned by a robotic machine at a pizza plant and died at the scene; OSHA and the medical examiner were investigating.
A driverless Waymo drove around a stopped school bus with its stop arm out; NHTSA opened PE25013 and Waymo recalled software on 3,067 vehicles (25E-084). No injuries.
An Avride delivery robot reportedly moved into a bike lane and threw a cyclist over the handlebars, injuring the rider, according to the cyclist and a lawyer.
Class II recall of da Vinci X, Xi and 5 systems: a software error let instrument arms that failed a ball-screw diagnostic stay in clinical use. No injuries stated.
Class II recall of 549 Mazor X robotic guidance systems for software errors that can cause incorrect instrument positioning during spinal surgery. No injuries stated.
Class II recall of 47 da Vinci 5 viewer displays with outdated firmware that can cause loss of 3D or all visualization while instruments stay active. No injuries stated.
A Waymo robotaxi struck a child who ran out from behind a double-parked SUV near an elementary school; minor injuries per Waymo. NHTSA opened a preliminary evaluation.
A Serve Robotics delivery robot hit and shattered the glass of a CTA bus shelter in West Town; no injuries reported, and Serve said it would cover repairs.
A Coco Robotics delivery robot hit a bus shelter at North Ave and Larrabee St in Old Town; Coco said it would pay for repairs.

Multiple Apollo Go robotaxis suddenly stalled, stranding passengers on busy overpasses; China reportedly suspended new robotaxi permits and Wuhan operations were reportedly halted pending investigation.
Class II recall of 2,781 da Vinci X and Xi manipulator arm parts whose screws may break, letting the cannula mount separate. No injuries stated.
Waymo vehicles missed ramp-closure signs and drove into freeway construction zones; after more events, Waymo recalled software on 3,871 vehicles (26E-035). No collisions described.
An unoccupied Waymo drove at reduced speed into a flooded lane on a 40 mph road; Waymo recalled software on 3,791 vehicles (26E-026). No collisions described.
An unoccupied Zoox entered an active fire scene in heavy smoke before being reversed out remotely; Zoox recalled software on 105 vehicles. No injuries identified.
An unoccupied Zoox robotaxi and a car collided on Las Vegas Boulevard at Four Seasons Drive; the car's driver was hospitalized with a minor injury. Fault not determined.
A humanoid robot being tested during a livestream swung an arm and knocked a streamer to the ground; no serious injuries were reported. Separately, it reportedly broke a shelf's glass during tests.
